scope_i18n.zh: 三组四柱鼎桁架及三面翼架构，保留中央开口。翼架节点、管径及接合为外观近似。
scope_i18n.ja: 三組四柱の鼎トラスと三面の翼架構。中央開口を残し、翼節点・管径・接合は外観近似。
scope_i18n.en: Three four-column kanae groups and three-face wing framing retain the central openings. Wing nodes, pipe sizes and joints are appearance approximations.

sections.scope: Actual model horizontal nodes and the wings rooted in the first four-column group.

scope_i18n.zh: 第一组鼎主柱与其左右翼架按原CAD杆件投影。12,500及25,000为模型竖向节点间距。
scope_i18n.ja: 第1鼎主柱と左右の翼を元CAD部材から投影。12,500・25,000はモデル鉛直節点間隔。
scope_i18n.en: The first kanae group and its adjacent rooted wings project actual CAD members. 12,500 and 25,000 are model vertical node intervals.
